intro.text: A middling highlord in Kholinar who controls food distribution in the city, guarded by soldiers in pale blue uniforms.

items.text: Velalant had been a minor figure in the city's politics, but rose in prominence as the higher-ranking highlords vanished into the palace. After the riots his guards took over an abandoned bank, Secure Keeps, and he struck a deal with the Wall Guard to hand out the food they Soulcast, keeping the peace in a market around his station.

personality.text: He seems to try to be fair, but his grain station is badly run, with hours-long queues and no attempt to put the needy first, and some grain goes to his guards and other lighteyes. Azure fears he and other highlords would attack the Wall Guard if cut out.
